start.title: He Is Passing By
start.text:
The Teacher walks through the press.
Twelve years of pain ache in you.

choices.feedback: Mark 5:27 — The woman came up in the crowd behind Jesus and touched his garment.

stay_consequence.title: Rise and Go
stay_consequence.text:
Healing waits where he walks.
Do not be left behind.

coins_consequence.title: Seek the Healer
coins_consequence.text:
Silver cannot mend what bleeds.
Only he can.

approach.title: Closer, Closer
approach.text:
Shoulders press, eyes do not see you.
His robe is near.

choices.feedback: Mark 5:27 — The woman came up in the crowd behind Jesus and touched his garment.

touch.title: The Hem
touch.text:
Your fingers brush the edge.
A stillness floods your bones.

choices.feedback: Mark 5:28 — The woman said, "If I touch even his garments, I will be made whole."

pull_consequence.title: It Is Done
pull_consequence.text:
The bleeding has stopped.
Receive what he has given.

doubt_consequence.title: Feel the Peace
doubt_consequence.text:
Twelve years of pain are gone.
This is grace.

healed.title: Made Whole
healed.text:
Strength returns. Light fills you.
Then he stops walking.

choices.feedback: Mark 5:33 — The woman, knowing what had happened to her, came in fear and trembling and fell down before Jesus.

slip_consequence.title: Do Not Hide
slip_consequence.text:
His gaze searches the crowd.
He wants to see you.

who_touched.title: Who Touched Me?
who_touched.text:
"Who touched my garment?"
The disciples shake their heads.

choices.feedback: Mark 5:33 — The woman, knowing what had happened to her, came in fear and trembling and fell down before Jesus and told him the whole truth.

hide_consequence.title: He Is Gentle
hide_consequence.text:
There is no anger in him.
Come forward.

deny_consequence.title: Speak the Truth
deny_consequence.text:
His mercy welcomes your story.
Do not be afraid.

confess.title: Trembling at His Feet
confess.text:
You tell him everything.
The whole street goes quiet.

peace.title: Daughter, Go in Peace
peace.text:
"Daughter, your faith has healed you.
Go in peace."
